name: acronym-bubble
description: Chrome extension: hover an acronym, see what it stands for.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/mova/bubble.jsx src/popup/popup.jsx --outdir dist --splitting --format esm --production --entry-naming '[name].[ext]' --chunk-naming 'chunk-[hash].[ext]' && tailwindcss -c src/mova/tailwind.config.cjs -i src/mova/mova.css -o dist/mova.css --minify && cp src/mova/LICENSE.mova dist/
scripts.check: bun run build && npm test && npm run e2e
scripts.zip: bun run build && rm -f acronym-bubble.zip && zip -qr acronym-bubble.zip manifest.json src/*.js src/*.css src/lib src/popup/popup.html dist icons -x '*.DS_Store'
